**![][image1]HACKER HANDBOOK**

**SummerHacks 2026**

August 8–9, 2026  ·  Stackt Market, Toronto

Welcome to SummerHacks 2026 presented by TECHNATION Career Ready Program\! We're so excited to have you here for a weekend of building, learning, and connecting.

SummerHacks is a celebration of creativity, technology, and community, hosted by the Open Skies Initiative. It's a space where technical skill meets imagination, where curiosity is encouraged, and where people from every background come together to build something meaningful.

### **Over the weekend, you'll:**

•     Build a project you're proud of

•     Enjoy new spaces that boost your imagination and innovation

•     Meet people who care about the same things you do

•     Take breaks, play games, and have fun along the way 

### **This handbook covers:**

•     Event logistics and emergency information

•     Where to get help and who to talk to

•     Meal schedule and dietary info

•     Project submission and judging details

•     Activities, workshops, and the full weekend schedule

 

If you ever feel lost or unsure, help is always nearby — an organizer, a volunteer, or a message on Discord.

**We're glad you're here. Let's make this weekend unforgettable.**

 

# **🤝 Sponsors**

SummerHacks 2026 is proudly supported by our sponsors, whose contributions help power the entire event.

### **Title Sponsor: TECHNATION Career Ready Program**

We are proud to be presented by TECHNATION Career Ready Program. Technation is Canada’s national tech industry association, and its Career Ready program is a federally funded wage-subsidy initiative that helps Canadian businesses and non-profits hire post-secondary students for tech-focused work placements. Since launching, the program has connected tens of thousands of students with employer partners across the country, making real-world tech experience more accessible for the next generation of talent. We are proud to have their support behind Summerhacks.

**✍ Registration**

Registration will occur from 9:00 – 11:30 AM on Saturday, August 8th in the Solarium. Hackers must ensure they are registered to be eligible to participate in the hackathon.

Please bring a piece of photo ID and proof of enrollment to show at registration

**🚨 Important: Register on Devpost**

[**https://summerhacksca.devpost.com/**](https://summerhacksca.devpost.com/)

Every hacker must create an account on Devpost and join (or create) their team there. This is where team formation, project submission, and judging all happen. 

Teams must ensure they are registered by 11:00 PM. Each team must submit a project draft to the Devpost and their project tracks.

Check-in will occur at 9:00 – 11:30 AM on Sunday, August 9th in the Solarium. For a project to be eligible, at least one member of the team must be checked in.

# **📤 Project Submission & Judging**

## **Rules**

1. Teams must consist of 2–4 hackers who have been accepted to SummerHacks 2026\. No solo submissions

Your team must be registered and formed on Devpost to be eligible by August 8 at 11:00PM — this is the system of record for submission and judging

2. All team members must have checked in at the venue on Saturday, August 8  
3. Everything you submit must be built during the hacking window — 26 hours, from 11:00 AM Saturday, August 8 to 1:00 PM Sunday, August 9  
4. Your idea must be original. It cannot be reused from a prior pitch competition, school project, hackathon, or grant proposal  
5. AI use is permitted as a tool, but the idea, design decisions, and creative direction should be your own  
6. Your team must pitch in person to a panel of judges during the designated judging period

## **Pitch**

At least one member on your team must be present at judging 

We encourage your pitch to focus on a demonstration of your product rather than a slide deck. 

Over the span of the judging period, you will present to judges multiple teams. Pitches will look like the following:

1\. 	1-minute project setup  
2\. 	4-minute pitch (including demo)  
3\. 	2-minute Q\&A  
4\. 	1-minute to leave  
 

 

 **🚨 Important:**

**Devpost : [https://summerhacksca.devpost.com/](https://summerhacksca.devpost.com/)**

**Track Submission: Saturday, August 8th @ 11pm, Soft Deadline: Sunday, August 9th @ 11am, Hard Deadline: Sunday, August 9th @ 1pm**

Submit your project through Devpost — the same platform where you registered and formed your team. Your submission should include your public github repository and a link to your deployed project. A powerpoint and video are nice, but they are not required 

# **🎉 The Third Space Trek**

*Work from somewhere new.*

**Why this exists**

Working the whole hackathon out of one room gets stale, and Toronto has a ton of good spaces to actually build in. Go explore the various third spaces that Toronto has to offer, starting from Stackt Marketplace

**How it works**

1\.     Ensure you have joined a team on the hacker portal

2\.    Set up and work from any cool third space location, we provided you a list of suggestions below.

3\.    Once per hour, snap a photo of your whole team working there (this is a team win, so all team members must appear in the photo, lanyards visible) and log it on the platform.

4\.    Total points across the hackathon determine the leaderboard. You have all of Saturday to explore\!

**Scoring**

| Photo is of… | Points | Details |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **A new spot** | 2 pts | Anywhere on the list you haven't logged yet this hackathon |
| **A repeat spot** | 1 pt | Back at a spot you've already logged |
| **Cadence** | 1 / hr | One scoring photo per hour max |

**The list**

Here’s a suggestion of a few spots to work at\! It’s not a to-do list; if you know other spaces, grind away there. For those of you who are cheeky, Stackt does count\~

| Location | Area | Tier | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Milky's Cloud Room** | Inside Stackt | Purchase | 1 min walk |
| **TPL Fort York Branch** | 4 min walk | Free | 3 min walk |
| **Waterworks Food Hall / The Well** | Queen St, \~600m–1km | Free | 9-11 min walk |
| **Botanic Coffee and Caphe** | Queen St, \~600m | Purchase | 12 min walk |
| **Scadding Court Community Ctr** | Bathurst & Dundas | Free | 7 min walk |
| **Fungo Cafe** | King St W | Purchase | 7 min walk |
| **Varda** | King St W (TIFF) | Purchase | 8 min streetcar |
| **ICHA TEA / Project Seoul / Café Forêt** | Chinatown | Purchase | \~8-12 min streetcar |
| **TPL Lillian H. Smith Branch** | College/Spadina | Free | 12 min streetcar |

**Ground rules**

•    **Respect the space and the people in it**. Keep it down, don't hog tables during their rush, pack out what you bring. Summerhacks is not responsible for hackers who are not present at Stackt Market, so please be respectful of the spaces you visit, and manage your own belongings.

•    Most café spots require a small purchase to work in the space\!

•    This is a team win — all team members must appear in every photo, lanyards visible, or it won't count.

•    Max one submitted photo per hour per team

•    Organizers review every photo for validity after final standings are locked at 11pm.

**Prize**

🏆  Top Explorer —awarded to the team with the highest verified point total on the leaderboard. Winning team members each receive a friend who also travels as frequently, just under the sea…
